user.title: Air Locker Map
user.description: Air quality from sensors in InPost parcel lockers. The API key is issued by the server administrator (/admin → API keys).

data_description.url: Public URL or local one, e.g. http://192.168.1.66:8080
data_description.mode: “Nearest to home” uses the location set in Home Assistant.

code.title: Parcel locker code
code.description: E.g. KAP01M or WAW84A. In “near a locker” mode it can be a locker without a sensor — the nearest working one is used.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the key (it may have been revoked). Paste a new one.

error.not_found: No such locker, or no working sensors nearby.

data_description.scan_minutes: The server refreshes data roughly hourly — polling more often than 10–15 min is pointless.
data_description.include_suspect: By default broken sensors are skipped in “nearest” modes.

options.locker: Nearest sensor to a given parcel locker
